_about: A11Y-001 baseline: serious/critical axe violations that existed when the scan was added (2026-11-11). Key = screen name used in a11y.spec.ts, '*' = every screen. Remove an entry once it is fixed; a new violation fails the test.

_notes.aria-input-field-name: The pane lists (role=listbox) have no accessible name; e.g. aria-label="Left pane".
_notes.aria-required-children: The operations panel tab strip (role=tablist) also holds non-tab buttons (Clear finished, Insights).
_notes.color-contrast: Muted text (inactive tab, empty-state text, palette group, column headers) is below 4.5:1.
_notes.label: The prompt dialog's text input has no label tied to the dialog title.
_notes.select-name: Multi Rename's '+ Add rule…' select has no accessible name.
